title: Chapter 359 Entering The Red Copper Mountain
content:
Chapter 359 Entering The Red Copper Mountain

Song Bo and the other two joined Wang Cuilian's team.

Wang Shuo's heart sank. Since you are looking for death and want to provoke me, don't blame me for being rude.

Looking at his sinister smile, you can tell that this guy has bad intentions.

Wang Shuo looked at Song Bo and smiled.

Song Bo seemed to have a sense of his heart and looked at Wang Shuo and smiled faintly.

Wang Cuilian cleared her throat and said seriously: "Before entering the Red Copper Mountain, I will briefly introduce the situation, so that everyone will not be confused later."

"Not long ago, Swan and I passed by this place. On the way, we encountered a fight between two gangs of villains. After both sides died, we searched them and found a real spirit pill that was hundreds of years old. At the same time, they also had a sword that was thousands of years old."

"From this, we guessed that there might be a relic inside. The two people got this thing from a cave left by a predecessor somewhere."

"So, we wanted to go in and find out, but along the way, there were traces of fighting everywhere, many people died, and there was even a dark gold boss blocking the way. We withdrew and planned to find more people to explore together."

Wang Cuilian told the cause and effect again.

"In this case, whether there are relics inside is still unknown?"

Someone couldn't help but wonder.

This news was exaggerated by someone with ulterior motives, and it caused such a big scene in the whole Yingying Town.

Wang Shuo was also speechless.

"But it's better to believe it!"

"We need to explore what's inside before we can know."

At this time, another eagle-nosed general said: "I have checked some information about Chitong Mountain these two days."

"This is the source of minerals for generals to mine and make weapons. There are not only a lot of copper mines, but also gold and iron mines. It is a mixed mine."

"It is said that a large-scale chaos occurred here decades ago. Some old people in the War General Tower still remember what happened back then."

"At that time, there were also people who said that there were strange treasures here. Countless people flocked here, but in the end, no one escaped."

"As a result, the generals at that time did not dare to come here again. Later, more and more generals entered. Some people who did not believe in evil did not encounter any accidents after entering, so everyone dared to step into Chitong Mountain again."

Wang Shuo was surprised when he heard these rumors.

These later people were all skeptical about this legend.

Since they are here, they must go in and find out.

Then everyone found a mine and entered one after another.

There are many mines outside the Red Copper Mountain. This place is basically mined by spontaneous organizations, and there is no plan at all.

There are pits everywhere.

At the same time, countless people began to pour into other tunnels.

Wang Shuo also followed the crowd and walked at the end.

Someone took out a torch and illuminated the surroundings.

Wang Shuo also took out his own torch. It was safer to have lighting equipment in his hand.

The mine they chose was quite narrow.

Not only can it only accommodate one person, but there are also many places where you have to bend down to move forward.

Mainly, the larger mines have been occupied by others.

After walking for a long time, there was no way.

"Damn! What a group of unprofessional miners." Someone complained.

Wang Shuo also stepped forward and explored carefully.

In the front, there was a rich ore exposed on the surface, but this ore, although the mineral content is high, still needs to be refined.

If the amount is too small, the value is still not high enough.

Everyone is not interested in collecting.

Wang Shuo stood there, lost in thought.

If the gold-eating demon worm Mira was here, he would be really rich.

Wang Shuo guessed that this huge mine was at least a level three mine.

There was no way out, so everyone had no choice but to return the way they came and find a new passage to enter.
